name: General Wellbeing
description: Everyday support for maintaining balance, building positive habits, and nurturing your overall mental, emotional, and physical wellness.

immediateActions.title: Morning Mindful Check-In
instructions: Pause before reaching for your phone or starting tasks
Sit comfortably and take 3 slow breaths to arrive in the present
Ask yourself: How is my body feeling this morning? Scan from head to toes briefly
Ask: What is one word for my mood right now?
Ask: What is one small thing I would like to make space for today?
Write or mentally note your answers and take one more breath before beginning

immediateActions.title: Three Good Things Reflection
instructions: Find a quiet moment near the end of your day
Think back through the whole day from waking until now
Write down 3 specific good things that happened, however small: a good cup of tea, a kind message, a task finished, nice weather
For each one, write one sentence about why it happened or what made it good
Place a hand over your heart and take 2 slow breaths to let that feeling land
Notice if there is anything you want to intentionally repeat or create tomorrow

immediateActions.title: 5-Minute Energy Boost Movement
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart
March in place lifting your knees for 60 seconds, swinging your arms
Do 10 slow arm circles forward then 10 backward
Step side to side for 60 seconds, gradually increasing speed if comfortable
Do 5 slow squats or knee bends, holding onto a surface if needed
Finish with 30 seconds of gentle bouncing on the balls of your feet, then stand still and notice your energy level

immediateActions.title: Micro-Connection Practice
instructions: Think of someone you care about who you have not connected with recently
Send them a short, genuine message: I thought of you today, hope you are doing well, or I enjoyed when we [memory]
Alternatively: say hello and thank you to someone who serves you today (barista, cashier, delivery person) with eye contact and a smile
Alternatively: give your full attention to a pet, plant, or even a favourite object in your home for 1 minute
Notice the feeling of connecting rather than scrolling alone
Journal one sentence about how that small interaction felt

safetyGuidance: General wellbeing is an ongoing, gentle practice rather than a destination. Some days will feel lighter and some days will feel harder, and both are completely normal. If you notice a persistent shift in your mood or functioning that lasts more than a couple of weeks, it may be worth checking in with a healthcare provider. Taking care of yourself is one of the most important things you can do.
